text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! An event where Umamusume express 
their gratitude to their supporting fans—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Then it's my time to shine!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Captain Hype Helios, in da buildingâ

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOOO!! Our party animal is 
heeeeeeere!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pop-pop-pop-POW!! Is that all you guys 
got?!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Make some noise, make some noooyz!! Today 
is~ uhhh~...?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's the Super! Mega! Ultra Fan 
Appreciation Festival! It's a festival for 
everyone, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Yo! Wanna bring it up?! Wanna bring it 
down?! Hey!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everybody, shout it loud and clear: 
S-C-R-E-A-M~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: I wanna raise iiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: K!! Then go wild as much as you want~~☆

And so, Daitaku Helios's Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival kicked off in rowdy fashion. Even 
after that—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Natureee~! Time for a freestyle battle!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez, just look at how I'm dressed! I'm 
not participating—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, what? A freestyle battle?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First up~! Sun Goddess, a.k.a. Poyopen, 
hit 'em with it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I'm Helios, keepin' it casual and hyped♪ 
Say ho, nothin' but success in sight, 
ay-oh♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Can you dig it, Nature? Just ride on this 
flooow♪ Keepin' it nat-u-ral, tell me how 
ya feel ya knoow♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...!? W-W-W-What!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: Nature!! Show 'em what you've got~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Nature! Nature! Nature! Nature!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nature a.k.a. Fluffiness goes on the 
offensive!!!! Bust 'em uuuuup~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, am I Nice Nature? Um... H-Hello? 
Uh... er."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eeeh... Argh, forget it!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nya-nyan-nyan-nya-nyaaaaa!!!! 
Nya-nya-nya-nyaaa!! Nya!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I LOOOOST——!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!!!! Nature won with pure vibes! 
So stroooong!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... I... I don't really know 
how, but I won...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what do you mean 'fluffiness is 
a strength'? What was everything up till 
now even for, then!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Mac-tan! Lookin' noble and cuuute as 
always today♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, Helios-san, you seem as 
energetic as ever.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, like, that swimsuit is so adorbs! 
Meanwhile I'm totally in a school 
swimsuit!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So McQueen's going all out too, huh. In 
this—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—"The Over-Remixed Song Intro Quiz 
Swimming Battle"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Over-Remixed Song Intro Quiz Swimming 
Battle"?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a moment, what in the world is 
that?! The event I am participating in is 
"Underwater Basket Toss"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I have no recollection of signing up for 
such a competition—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
One of my besties is a total original 
song-wrecker~. It's freaking hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I shared the audio clip of it! And now, 
an intro quiz to guess the song♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Once you swim over, smash that buzzer! 
Btw, I dunno what's inside either, so it's 
super fair☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the management were opposed 
to it, weren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It sounded fun, so I instantly said okay!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The staff members...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, we doing it or not? Not doing it or 
doing it?? Wait, was there a reward for 
this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Very well, I accept your challenge. As 
a horse girl of the Mejiro family, I take 
great pride in my musical knowledge.
(Pippo-hempoo-poyapoya-fufu-ja♪)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
!? What is this song?! Can you even call 
it music?!
(Splaash!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The correct answer is "My 
Grandfather's Clock"!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayyy! My win☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I didn't understand a single thing. 
Chopin is... Bach is...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaha, that's impossible for an intro 
quiz~! Not gonna lie, mine was just a 
guess too!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
“A reward for our winner, Daitaku Helios! 
Please enjoy the cafeteria head chef's 
special carrot cake, available only 
today!”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, for real!? Super rare!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Btw Mac-tan, wanna split some cake?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, you are the one who won. Are you 
truly fine with this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Mactan, the hype was totally 
insane! Plus, wouldn't keeping something 
rare all to yourself be a waste?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let me know what kind of tea goes with it☆ 
I'll be waiting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* If that is the case, I would be 
delighted to accompany you.
